summoners.name: Aldric Stonebanner
summoners.lore: A field captain who carries the last lawful standard.

summoners.name: Lady Serane Vale
summoners.lore: A court duelist who turns a narrow line into a fortress.

summoners.name: Torvane Crownshield
summoners.lore: The vanished king’s shield, still obeying an unfinished oath.

summoners.name: Bram Forgewarden
summoners.lore: A practical armorer who improves only what can bear the weight.

summoners.name: Maelor Ironhand
summoners.lore: A queen without a throne who refuses to lose another soldier.

summoners.name: Eira Thornpath
summoners.lore: The quickest guide through the moving briar roads.

summoners.name: Rowan Packmother
summoners.lore: She teaches rival beasts to hunt as one court.

summoners.name: Garran Moonfang
summoners.lore: A moon-crowned warlord who times every charge to the old sky.

summoners.name: Pip Briarwhistle
summoners.lore: A hedge scout whose whistle always arrives before the ambush.

summoners.name: Ysilde Whitehart
summoners.lore: The antlered judge of every hunt taken without need.

summoners.name: Oris Glassmoth
summoners.lore: A soft-spoken envoy whose wings remember every lie.

summoners.name: Miravel Threadseer
summoners.lore: She knots two possible futures and cuts the one she dislikes.

summoners.name: Veyra Nine-Masks
summoners.lore: No witness agrees on which face led the battle.

summoners.name: Fen Quill
summoners.lore: A contract witch who writes the weakness after seeing it.

summoners.name: The Lacquered Oracle
summoners.lore: Its painted prophecies speak twice, never quite the same way.

summoners.name: Morcant Bellkeeper
summoners.lore: Each toll reminds the dead which side of the gate they chose.

summoners.name: Abbess Nhal
summoners.lore: She collects no coin, only promises left at graves.

summoners.name: King Ossuary
summoners.lore: A monarch assembled from the bones of those who broke faith.

summoners.name: Tallow Jack
summoners.lore: A candle bearer who makes small ghosts surprisingly difficult to extinguish.

summoners.name: Vel Mourningstar
summoners.lore: The general who schedules revenge with funeral precision.

summoners.name: Cael Rookwing
summoners.lore: A cliff-born captain with a rook’s eye for weak seams.

summoners.name: Maris Cloudreel
summoners.lore: She measures battle lines as if they were weather fronts.

summoners.name: Duke Avorran
summoners.lore: Aerial nobility distilled into ruthless coordination.

summoners.name: Tess Kestrel
summoners.lore: The youngest courier ever to outrun a storm drake.

summoners.name: Saint Orien of the Gale
summoners.lore: A canonized hunter who believes every tyrant can be moved.

summoners.name: Vaelor Runeclaw
summoners.lore: A rune-carver who reads ancestry in every scale.

summoners.name: Syrra Hoardseer
summoners.lore: She values the mana deliberately left unspent.

summoners.name: Orrun the First Scale
summoners.lore: An elder whose first scar predates the current crown.

summoners.name: Kiva Emberledger
summoners.lore: A hoard accountant who turns restraint into certainty.

summoners.name: Thalor Worldcoil
summoners.lore: A sleeping giant whose breath makes old blood remember itself.
